      (NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P (NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P k j)
              (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j false outs)).run =
          false ∧
        ((NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P (NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P k j)
                (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j false outs)).dec =

doc: Network readout bound from the switching bound.
name: NimAudit.Coverage.network_readout_bound_switching
type:
∀ {W M B N j r L : ℕ},
  j < B →
    ∀ (nets : Bool → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
      (∀ (b : Bool), (nets b).length = L) →
        (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W (nets b)) →
          (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M (nets b)) →
            N + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r →
              ∀ {p ε : ℚ},
                0 ≤ p →
                  p ≤ 1 →
                    (∀ (m : ℕ),
                        N + 1 ≤ m →
                          m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                            NimAudit.Foundation.SwitchingBound (3 * L + 2 + 11)
                              (12 *
                                NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B
                                    ((r + 1) * (2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ L * (M + 1) ^ (W * L)) + 1)) ^
                                  10)
                              m p ε) →
                      NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                            (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1) fun b =>
                              NimAudit.BinReadout.netBCirc W B (N + 1) r (nets b))
                            j /
                          NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
                        2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

single-change domain, then c = 1 (test pair Q = Q′ = 0) and S is the global mask.
name: NimAudit.Fourier.char_unique_signed
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.Field R] [inst_1 : LE R] [inst_2 : LT R] [Std.LawfulOrderLT R]
  [inst_4 : Std.IsLinearOrder R] [Grind.OrderedRing R] {B N q : ℕ},
  q < B →
    ∀ {S : List Bool},
      S ∈ NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (2 * (B * N)) →
        ∀ {c : R},
          (∀ (Q Q' : List ℕ),
              Q.length = N →
                Q'.length = N →
                  NimAudit.Game.Width B Q →
                    NimAudit.Game.Width B Q' →
                      NimAudit.LocalRestore.OneChange Q Q' →
                        c * NimAudit.Fourier.chi S (NimAudit.Fourier.enc B N Q Q') =
                          NimAudit.Noise.sg
                            ((NimAudit.nimSum Q ^^^ NimAudit.nimSum Q').testBit q)) →
            c = 1 ∧ S = NimAudit.Fourier.gMask B N q

doc:
LOSSLESS ON REACHABLE STATES: along a well-formed stream every reachable semantic
state fits the fields (counter included: idx ≤ N < 2^r, so no overflow) and is
recovered exactly from its 4 + 5B + 3r state bits.
name: NimAudit.ControllerBits.reachable_lossless
type:
∀ {B r N : ℕ},
  N < 2 ^ r →
    ∀ (Ps : List (List ℕ)),
      (∀ P ∈ Ps, P.length = N ∧ NimAudit.Game.Width B P) →
        ∀
          st ∈

doc:
CONDITIONAL COMPLEXITY CONSEQUENCE (logic only).  For ANY predicate `C` on
Boolean functions and ANY predicate `S` on selectors, assuming
  (closure)  S sel implies C (bs ↦ decodeHead (sel (encode bs))), and
  (hardness) ¬ C parity,
no selector satisfying S is a winning-move selector.  Instantiating C as
"computable by polynomial-size constant-depth circuits" requires the
closure of that class under the encoding/decoding, and the parity lower
bound; NEITHER is formalised here.  They are explicit hypotheses.
name: NimAudit.Game.no_winning_selector_of_hardness
type:
∀ (C : (List Bool → Bool) → Prop) (S : (List ℕ → Option (List ℕ)) → Prop),
  (∀ (sel : List ℕ → Option (List ℕ)),
      S sel → C fun bs => NimAudit.Game.decodeHead (sel (NimAudit.Game.encode bs))) →
    ¬C NimAudit.Game.parity →
      ∀ (sel : List ℕ → Option (List ℕ)),
        S sel →
          ¬∀ (p : List ℕ),
              NimAudit.Game.Win p →
                ∃ q, sel p = some q ∧ NimAudit.Game.Move p q ∧ NimAudit.Game.Lose q

doc:
BIT-LEVEL WHOLE-GAME THEOREM: with N < 2^r and N ≤ 2^r', from the encoding of any idle
state storing a width-B board of N slots, the one-pass bit-level machine wins from every
nonzero board of width B against every legal opponent.
name: NimAudit.BoardStore.bits_store_wins
type:
∀ {B N r r' : ℕ},
  N < 2 ^ r →
    N ≤ 2 ^ r' →
      ∀ (P : List ℕ),
        P.length = N →
          NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
            NimAudit.nimSum P ≠ 0 →
              ∀ (b : List ℕ),
                b.length = N →

doc:
ONE QUERY = L_j + 2 ticks: L_j moves, the terminal test, and one consume tick that
stores the outcome and then stops or advances to head j+1 with the board reloaded.
name: NimAudit.Shootout.query_step
type:
∀ (early : Bool) (B : ℕ) (P : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) (dec : Bool) (outs : ℕ → Bool),
  ∃ Qe,
    (NimAudit.Shootout.arun early B P (NimAudit.Rollout.rolloutMoves j P + 2)
          (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j dec outs) =
        if (early && NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner j P || decide (j = B - 1)) = true then
          { rs := { board := Qe, par := NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner j P, halted := true },
            run := false, dec := dec || NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner j P, j := j,
            outs := NimAudit.Shootout.upd outs j (NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner j P) }
        else
          NimAudit.Shootout.ld P (j + 1) (dec || NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner j P)
            (NimAudit.Shootout.upd outs j (NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner j P))) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ NimAudit.Rollout.rolloutMoves j P + 1,
        (NimAudit.Shootout.arun early B P u (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j dec outs)).run = true

doc:
RESTRICTION/AVERAGING BRIDGE: under the premise at m = ones mask, the
correlation of any circuit (depth ≤ d, size ≤ s, reading only the |mask|
coordinates) with the MASKED parity is at most ε.
name: NimAudit.Bridge.masked_correlation
type:
∀ (mask : List Bool) (C : NimAudit.AC0.Circ) {d s : ℕ} {ε : ℚ},
  C.maxInput ≤ mask.length →
    C.depth ≤ d →
      C.size ≤ s →
        NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise d s (NimAudit.Bridge.ones mask) ε →
          -ε ≤
              (NimAudit.Prob.rsum (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs mask.length) fun x =>
                  NimAudit.Bridge.ind (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Bridge.vfun x) C) *
                    NimAudit.Bridge.sgn (NimAudit.Bridge.pm mask x)) /
                2 ^ mask.length ∧
            (NimAudit.Prob.rsum (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs mask.length) fun x =>

L, then its first K i outputs (K polynomial) are computed by the compiled formulas
netFormula W (len i) (net i), which form an AC0 family of depth ≤ 3L reading only the
len inputs; on unpadded inputs the formulas equal the networks (Wired, nonempty).

    ∀ (K : ι → ℕ),
      NimAudit.Family.PolyIn adm len K →
        NimAudit.Family.AC0Fam adm len
            (fun i => List.map (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W (len i) (net i)) (List.range (K i)))

          ∀ (i : ι),
            adm i →
              net i ≠ [] →

doc: GENERIC SELECTOR EXACTNESS.
name: NimAudit.SelectCircuit.genSel_correct
type:
∀ {B N : ℕ} {P : List ℕ},
  P.length = N →
    NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
      ∀ (z : ℕ → Bool),
        (∀ j < B * N, z j = NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P j) →
          ∀ (prim : ℕ → NimAudit.AC0.Circ) (pv : ℕ → ℕ → NimAudit.AC0.Circ) (pr : ℕ → Bool)
            (f : ℕ → ℕ),
            (∀ i < N, NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval z (prim i) = pr (P.getD i 0)) →
              (∀ (x : ℕ), pr x = true → 0 < x) →
                (∀ (x : ℕ), pr x = true → x < 2 ^ B → f x < 2 ^ B) →
                  (∀ i < N,
                      ∀ p < B,
                        pr (P.getD i 0) = true →
                          NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval z (pv i p) =
                            (f (P.getD i 0)).testBit (B - 1 - p)) →

every y, Q is a predecessor of Game.encode y with nim(Q) = 0 reached by a legal move.  The

                ∃ Q,
                  Q.length = m + 1 ∧
                    NimAudit.nimSum Q = 0 ∧
                      NimAudit.Game.Move Q (NimAudit.Game.encode y) ∧
                        ∀ w < 2 * (m + 1),
                          NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Bridge.vfun y)

type:
∀ (early : Bool) (B : ℕ) (P : List ℕ) (s : NimAudit.Shootout.OS),
  NimAudit.Shootout.ostep early B P false s =
    {
      rs :=
        if (s.run && s.rs.halted && !NimAudit.Shootout.coreB early B s) = true then
          { board := P, par := false, halted := false }
        else
          if (s.run && !s.rs.halted) = true then
            NimAudit.RolloutExec.rsStep (NimAudit.SelectCircuit.policyIdx s.j) s.rs
          else s.rs,
      run := s.run && !(s.run && s.rs.halted && NimAudit.Shootout.coreB early B s),
      dec := s.dec || s.run && s.rs.halted && s.rs.par,
      j :=
        if (s.run && s.rs.halted && !NimAudit.Shootout.coreB early B s) = true then s.j + 1
        else s.j,
      outs := fun h =>
        if (s.run && s.rs.halted && decide (h = s.j)) = true then s.rs.par else s.outs h }

doc:
ASYMPTOTIC SINGLE-CHANNEL THEOREM (thm:search-gap (i), asymptotic form), conditional
only on the external classical input.  Fix B ≥ 2 and j < B.  Let R N b be binary
readout formulas for N+1 heaps with BBound of FIXED depth d and size s N, index width
r N, where s and r are polynomially bounded in N+1.  Then there is a negligible η with
  success_N ≤ 2/(2^B − 1) + η N   for every N.
name: NimAudit.ClassicalBoundary.search_gap_asymptotic
type:
NimAudit.ClassicalBoundary.HastadNegl →
  ∀ {B j : ℕ},
    j < B →
      ∀ (R : ℕ → Bool → NimAudit.BinReadout.BCirc) (r s : ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ),
        (∀ (N : ℕ) (b : Bool), NimAudit.BinReadout.BBound (R N b) (N + 1) B (r N) d (s N)) →
          (∃ c k, ∀ (N : ℕ), s N ≤ c * (N + 1) ^ k ∧ r N ≤ c * (N + 1) ^ k) →
            ∃ η,
              NimAudit.ClassicalBoundary.Negligible η ∧
                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                  NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                        (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1) (R N)) j /
                      NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
                    2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + η N

doc:
FINITE-INPUT SIMULATION THEOREM (same formula for all four properties).
For a valid network of L = ls.length layers with fan-ins and widths ≤ M and any
input length n, output i is computed (on zero-extended n-bit inputs) by
netFormula W n ls i, which has depth ≤ 3L, size ≤ 2 (2W+3)^L (M+1)^(WL) and reads
only inputs < n.
name: NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula_spec
type:
∀ {W M : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (ls : List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
  NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W ls →
    NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M ls →
      ∀ (i : ℕ),
        (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool),
            NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n ls i) =
              NimAudit.AC0.evalNet ls (NimAudit.FiniteNet.pad n x) i) ∧
          (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n ls i).depth ≤ 3 * ls.length ∧
            (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n ls i).size ≤
                2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ ls.length * (M + 1) ^ (W * ls.length)) ∧
              (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n ls i).maxInput ≤ n

doc:

doc:
CONDITIONAL BOUND FOR BINARY READOUTS: binary readout formulas with BBound
(depth ≤ d, size ≤ s, r index bits, N+1 ≤ 2^r) fed RO_{pi_j} succeed with
conditional probability ≤ 2/(q-1) + (q-1) ε, under the parity-correlation
premise for depth d + 13 and size 12 U^10, U = (N+3)(B+2)((r+1)(s+1)+2).

type:
∀ {B N j r d s : ℕ},
  j < B →
    ∀ (R : Bool → NimAudit.BinReadout.BCirc),
      (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.BinReadout.BBound (R b) (N + 1) B r d s) →
        ∀ {ε : ℚ},
          (∀ (m : ℕ),
              N + 1 ≤ m →
                m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                  NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (d + 2 + 11)
                    (12 * NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B ((r + 1) * (s + 1)) ^ 10) m ε) →
            NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1) (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1) R) j /
                NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
              2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

doc:

terminal tests + B consume ticks = totalRolloutMoves + 2B + 1 controller ticks, then ONE
readout-network evaluation: totalRolloutMoves + 2B + 2 network evaluations in all
(phase 6's functional composition counted totalRolloutMoves + 2B + 1: B separate
resets instead of 1 reset + B consume/reload ticks).

    ∀ {P : List ℕ},
      NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
        1 + NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P (B - 1) 0 = NimAudit.Game.totalRolloutMoves B P + 2 * B + 1 ∧
          NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P (B - 1) 0 ≤ NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B P.length ∧
            NimAudit.Game.totalRolloutMoves B P ≤ B * (P.length * (2 ^ B - 1))

the phase-6 agreement identity Misc.flip_agree is the event probability agree ε L.

  0 ≤ ε →
    ε ≤ 1 →

elsewhere; exact degree N; tail 1 below N and 0 from N on.
name: NimAudit.Fourier.nimBit_spectrum
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.Field R] [inst_1 : LE R] [inst_2 : LT R] [Std.LawfulOrderLT R]

    (∀ T ∈ NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (B * N),
        NimAudit.Fourier.coef (B * N) (NimAudit.Fourier.nimBitSign B N j) T =
          if T = NimAudit.Bridge.maskU B N (2 ^ j) then 1 else 0) ∧
      NimAudit.Bridge.ones (NimAudit.Bridge.maskU B N (2 ^ j)) = N ∧
        NimAudit.Fourier.ExactDeg (B * N) (NimAudit.Fourier.nimBitSign B N j) N ∧
          ∀ (k : ℕ),
            NimAudit.Fourier.tail (B * N) (NimAudit.Fourier.nimBitSign B N j) k =

doc:

formula of depth ≤ d and size ≤ M reading the B·N board bits has squared correlation at
most η with nim-sum bit j (a character of degree N), provided the premise holds at some
k < N.

type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.Field R] [inst_1 : LE R] [inst_2 : LT R] [Std.LawfulOrderLT R]
  [inst_4 : Std.IsLinearOrder R] [Grind.OrderedRing R] {B N j d M k : ℕ} {η : R},
  j < B →
    k < N →
      NimAudit.Fourier.TailPremise (B * N) d M k η →
        ∀ (C : NimAudit.AC0.Circ),
          C.depth ≤ d →
            C.size ≤ M →
              C.maxInput ≤ B * N →
                NimAudit.Fourier.ip (B * N)
                      (fun x =>
                        NimAudit.Noise.sg (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Bridge.vfun x) C))
                      (NimAudit.Fourier.nimBitSign B N j) ^
                    2 ≤
                  η

    if NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P) (R' b).valid = true then
      match
        NimAudit.CorrBridge.firstTrue
          (List.map (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P)) (R' b).sel) with

                  (List.map (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P))
                    (R' b).val) <
                x then

                (List.map (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P)) (R' b).val)
          else 0
        | none => 0

are legal simulated moves + R terminal-test steps + R consume ticks (R − 1 of which also
reload the board for the next head; the last stops) — i.e. 1 + Σ_{h<R} L_h + 2R ticks —

                  (List.range (NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0))).sum +
              2 * NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0 ∧
          NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0 ≤ B ∧
            (NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner 0 P = true → NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0 = 1) ∧

  1 ≤ B →
    B ≤ 2 ^ r →
      ∀ {P : List ℕ},

          NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
            ∀ (x0 : ℕ → Bool),
              (NimAudit.Shootout.loopRun (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep true B N r P false) (B * N + 2)
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B N)
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep true B N r P true x0)).2 =
                  NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0 ∧
                (NimAudit.Shootout.loopRun (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep true B N r P false) (B * N + 2)
                        (NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B N)
                        (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep true B N r P true x0)).1

                  decide (NimAudit.nimSum P ≠ 0)

doc:
WORKED INSTANCE of the remark's numbers ε = 1/100, L = 50: a = (49/50)^50 lies in
[0.364, 0.3644], the small-bias condition 2a ≤ 1 holds, 31·a² ≥ 4, and therefore 31
fresh repetitions with the majority rule give both error probabilities ≤ 1/4 (errors
computed on the error space of 31·50 independent flips).
name: NimAudit.Noise.remark_instance
type:
364 ≤ 1000 * (1 - 2 * (1 / 100)) ^ 50 ∧
  10000 * (1 - 2 * (1 / 100)) ^ 50 ≤ 3644 ∧
    2 * (1 - 2 * (1 / 100)) ^ 50 ≤ 1 ∧
      4 ≤ ↑31 * ((1 - 2 * (1 / 100)) ^ 50) ^ 2 ∧
        (4 *
              NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (31 * 50)) fun e =>
                NimAudit.Noise.fw (1 / 100) e *
                  NimAudit.Noise.detRule NimAudit.Noise.maj (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf false 50 31 e)) ≤
            1 ∧
          (4 *
              NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (31 * 50)) fun e =>
                NimAudit.Noise.fw (1 / 100) e *
                  (1 -
                    NimAudit.Noise.detRule NimAudit.Noise.maj
                      (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf true 50 31 e))) ≤
            1

name: NimAudit.BinReadout.netReadout_eq
type:
∀ {W B N r : ℕ} (nets : Bool → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
  (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W (nets b)) →
    ∀ {P : List ℕ},
      P.length = N →
        ∀ (b : Bool),
          NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B N
              (fun b => NimAudit.BinReadout.netBCirc W B N r (nets b)) P b =
            if NimAudit.AC0.evalNet (nets b) (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P) 0 = true then
              if
                  NimAudit.Bridge.toNatBE
                      (List.map
                        (fun q =>
                          NimAudit.AC0.evalNet (nets b) (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P) (1 + q))
                        (List.range r)) <
                    N then
                some
                  (NimAudit.Bridge.toNatBE
                      (List.map
                        (fun q =>
                          NimAudit.AC0.evalNet (nets b) (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P) (1 + q))
                        (List.range r)),
                    NimAudit.Bridge.toNatBE
                      (List.map
                        (fun p =>
                          NimAudit.AC0.evalNet (nets b) (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P)
                            (1 + r + p))
                        (List.range B)))
              else none
            else none

doc:
PER-UPDATE CIRCUIT CORRECTNESS (k < B): the circuits compute the new state bits
and, at a separator, the output bits.
name: NimAudit.Recurrent.circuit_update
type:
∀ {B k : ℕ},
  k < B →
    ∀ (s : NimAudit.Recurrent.State) (t : NimAudit.Recurrent.Token),
      NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Recurrent.encode B s t) (NimAudit.Recurrent.accC B k) =
          (NimAudit.Recurrent.step s t).1.acc.testBit k ∧
        NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Recurrent.encode B s t) (NimAudit.Recurrent.prevC B k) =
            (NimAudit.Recurrent.step s t).1.prev.testBit k ∧
          NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Recurrent.encode B s t) (NimAudit.Recurrent.validC B) =
              (NimAudit.Recurrent.step s t).1.valid ∧
            (t = NimAudit.Recurrent.Token.sep →
              NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Recurrent.encode B s t) (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input k) =
                  s.acc.testBit k ∧
                NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Recurrent.encode B s t)
                      (NimAudit.Recurrent.diffC B k) =
                    (s.prev ^^^ s.acc).testBit k ∧
                  NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Recurrent.encode B s t)
                      (NimAudit.Recurrent.diffValidC B) =
                    s.valid)

doc:
FEEDFORWARD SIMULATION THEOREM (one network).  A valid network of L layers with
all fan-ins and widths ≤ M, on inputs x_0..x_{n-1} (n ≤ M), is computed output by
output by formulas of depth ≤ 3L and size ≤ 2 (2W+3)^L (M+1)^(W L), reading only
inputs < n.
name: NimAudit.AC0.network_ac0
type:
∀ {W M n : ℕ} (ls : List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
  NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W ls →
    NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M ls →
      ∀ (i : ℕ),
        (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool),
            NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W ls NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input i) =
              NimAudit.AC0.evalNet ls x i) ∧
          (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W ls NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input i).depth ≤ 3 * ls.length ∧
            (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W ls NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input i).size ≤
                2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ ls.length * (M + 1) ^ (W * ls.length)) ∧
              (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W ls
                    (fun j =>
                      if j < n then NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input j else NimAudit.AC0.Circ.const false)
                    i).maxInput ≤
                n

        (NimAudit.Shootout.arun false B P (NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P k j)
                (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j dec outs)).run =
            false ∧
          (∀ h < B,
              (NimAudit.Shootout.arun false B P (NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P k j)
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j dec outs)).outs
                  h =
                NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner h P) ∧
            ∀ u < NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P k j,
              (NimAudit.Shootout.arun false B P u (NimAudit.Shootout.ld P j dec outs)).run = true

name: NimAudit.BinReadout.network_readout_bound
type:
∀ {W M B N j r L : ℕ},
  j < B →
    ∀ (nets : Bool → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
      (∀ (b : Bool), (nets b).length = L) →
        (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W (nets b)) →
          (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M (nets b)) →
            N + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r →
              ∀ {ε : ℚ},
                (∀ (m : ℕ),
                    N + 1 ≤ m →
                      m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                        NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (3 * L + 2 + 11)
                          (12 *
                            NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B
                                ((r + 1) * (2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ L * (M + 1) ^ (W * L)) + 1)) ^
                              10)
                          m ε) →
                  NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                        (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1) fun b =>
                          NimAudit.BinReadout.netBCirc W B (N + 1) r (nets b))
                        j /
                      NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
                    2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

doc:
ASYMPTOTIC FORM (absolute-error convention).  Fix B ≥ 2, j < B, d ≥ 9 and size
bounds s N ≥ 10 ((N+3)(B+2))^8.  If the premise holds for every N with error
ε N and ε is negligible, then there is δ with δ N ≥ 0, δ negligible, such that
for every N the explicit circuits succeed with exactly 2/(q-1) and every
readout in the class succeeds with at most 2/(q-1) + δ N.
name: NimAudit.AttainCircuit.asymptotic_sharpness
type:
∀ {B j d : ℕ},
  2 ≤ B →
    j < B →
      9 ≤ d →
        ∀ (s : ℕ → ℕ),
          (∀ (N : ℕ), 10 * NimAudit.AttainCircuit.Ua (N + 1) B ^ 8 ≤ s N) →
            ∀ (ε : ℕ → ℚ),
              NimAudit.Prob.Negligible ε →
                (∀ (N m : ℕ),
                    N + 1 ≤ m →
                      m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                        NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (d + 11)
                          (12 * NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B (s N) ^ 10) m (ε N)) →
                  ∃ δ,
                    NimAudit.Prob.Negligible δ ∧
                      (∀ (N : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ N) ∧
                        ∀ (N : ℕ),
                          NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                                  (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B
                                    (NimAudit.AttainCircuit.attR B (N + 1)
                                      (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                                      (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true)))
                                  j /
                                NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) =
                              2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) ∧
                            ∀ (R : Bool → NimAudit.CorrBridge.RCirc),
                              (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.CorrBridge.RBound (R b) (N + 1) B d (s N)) →
                                NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                                      (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B R) j /
                                    NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤

doc:
GATE-REALISED COMPOSITION THEOREM.  If every stage is a W-valid network with at most L
layers and widths/fan-ins ≤ M, the K-stage model is computed (on zero-extended n-bit
inputs) by formulas of depth ≤ 3·K·L, size ≤ 2 (2W+3)^{KL} (M+1)^{W·KL}, reading only
the n inputs; the formulas compute the staged evaluation.
name: NimAudit.Windows.staged_ac0
type:
∀ {W M L : ℕ} (sts : List (List NimAudit.AC0.Layer)),
  (∀ st ∈ sts, NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W st) →
    (∀ st ∈ sts, NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M st) →
      (∀ st ∈ sts, st.length ≤ L) →
        ∀ (n i : ℕ),
          (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool),
              NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n sts.flatten i) =
                NimAudit.Windows.runStages sts (NimAudit.FiniteNet.pad n x) i) ∧
            (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n sts.flatten i).depth ≤ 3 * (sts.length * L) ∧
              (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n sts.flatten i).size ≤
                  2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ (sts.length * L) * (M + 1) ^ (W * (sts.length * L))) ∧
                (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n sts.flatten i).maxInput ≤ n

doc:

opponent move Q → Q', the purely local circuit (no global nim-sum) selects a legal
reply restoring nim-sum 0, identical to `NimGame.restore`.
name: NimAudit.Coverage.two_frame_restoration
type:
∀ {B N : ℕ} {Q Q' : List ℕ},
  Q.length = N →
    Q'.length = N →
      NimAudit.Game.Width B Q →
        NimAudit.Game.Width B Q' →
          NimAudit.nimSum Q = 0 →
            NimAudit.Game.Move Q Q' →
              ∃ i v,
                NimAudit.SelectCircuit.selReadout (NimAudit.LocalRestore.restC B N)
                      (NimAudit.LocalRestore.tf B N Q Q') =
                    some (i, v) ∧
                  NimAudit.Game.Move Q' (Q'.set i v) ∧
                    NimAudit.nimSum (Q'.set i v) = 0 ∧
                      NimAudit.SelectCircuit.SelBound (NimAudit.LocalRestore.restC B N) N B
                        (4 + 9 + 4)
                        (12 * ((N + 2) * (B + 2) * (B * (2 * B + 3) + 9 + 2)) ^ 8 *
                          (10 * N + 1 + 1))
                        (2 * (B * N))

doc:
BINARY SHARPNESS: the explicit binary circuits for the least fibre representatives
succeed with exactly 2/(2^B − 1), satisfy BBound (depth 12, size
4((N+3)(10·Ua(N+1) B^8 + 2))^3, r index bits), and under the parity-correlation
premise every binary readout with the same bounds succeeds with at most
2/(2^B − 1) + (2^B − 1)ε.
name: NimAudit.PriorityEncoder.attainBin_sharp
type:
∀ {B N j r : ℕ},
  2 ≤ B →
    j < B →
      N + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r →
        ∀ {ε : ℚ},
          (∀ (m : ℕ),
              N + 1 ≤ m →
                m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                  NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (9 + 3 + 2 + 11)
                    (12 *
                      NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B
                          ((r + 1) *
                            (4 *
                                ((N + 1 + 2) * (10 * NimAudit.AttainCircuit.Ua (N + 1) B ^ 8 + 2)) ^
                                  3 +
                              1)) ^
                        10)
                    m ε) →
            (∀ (b : Bool),
                NimAudit.BinReadout.BBound
                  (NimAudit.PriorityEncoder.attainBin B (N + 1) r
                    (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                    (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true) b)
                  (N + 1) B r (9 + 3)
                  (4 * ((N + 1 + 2) * (10 * NimAudit.AttainCircuit.Ua (N + 1) B ^ 8 + 2)) ^ 3)) ∧
              NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                      (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1)
                        (NimAudit.PriorityEncoder.attainBin B (N + 1) r
                          (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                          (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true)))
                      j /
                    NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) =
                  2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) ∧
                ∀ (R : Bool → NimAudit.BinReadout.BCirc),
                  (∀ (b : Bool),
                      NimAudit.BinReadout.BBound (R b) (N + 1) B r (9 + 3)
                        (4 *
                          ((N + 1 + 2) * (10 * NimAudit.AttainCircuit.Ua (N + 1) B ^ 8 + 2)) ^ 3)) →
                    NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                          (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1) R) j /
                        NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
                      2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

doc:
SHARPNESS (finite, two-sided).  For B ≥ 2, N ≥ 1 and a structured head j < B:
(1) the explicit readout attains exactly 2/(q-1);
(2) every readout satisfying CorrHyp with error η succeeds with conditional
    probability at most 2/(q-1) + (q-1) η.
Hence no constant below 2/(q-1) can replace the leading term in (2) for any
class containing the explicit readout, PROVIDED that readout satisfies the
correlation premise with η_N → 0.  That proviso is the circuit/correlation
bridge (targets C/D); it is not proved here.
name: NimAudit.Attain.sharpness
type:
∀ {B N j : ℕ},
  2 ≤ B →
    j < B →
      NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
              (NimAudit.Attain.attainF (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true))
              j /
            NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) =
          2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) ∧
        ∀ (F : NimAudit.Prob.Readout) (η : ℚ),
          NimAudit.Prob.CorrHyp B (N + 1) F η →
            NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1) F j / NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
              2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * η

doc:
CONDITIONAL SHARPNESS (targets A + C + D combined).  Fix B ≥ 2, a structured
head j < B, N ≥ 1 (written N + 1), and resource bounds d ≥ 9,
s ≥ 10 ((N+3)(B+2))^8.  ASSUME the classical parity-correlation premise with
error ε for formulas of depth ≤ d + 11 and size ≤ 12 U^10 (U = (N+3)(B+2)(s+2))
on every m with N + 1 ≤ m ≤ B (N + 1).  Then:
(1) the explicit attainability circuits lie in the class (RBound d s);
(2) fed RO_{pi_j}, they succeed with conditional probability exactly 2/(q-1);
(3) they satisfy CorrHyp with error ε;
(4) every readout in the class succeeds with conditional probability
    ≤ 2/(q-1) + (q-1) ε.
So the optimum over the class lies in [2/(q-1), 2/(q-1) + (q-1) ε].
name: NimAudit.AttainCircuit.conditional_sharpness
type:
∀ {B N j d s : ℕ},
  2 ≤ B →
    j < B →
      9 ≤ d →
        10 * NimAudit.AttainCircuit.Ua (N + 1) B ^ 8 ≤ s →
          ∀ {ε : ℚ},
            (∀ (m : ℕ),
                N + 1 ≤ m →
                  m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                    NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (d + 11)
                      (12 * NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B s ^ 10) m ε) →
              (∀ (b : Bool),
                  NimAudit.CorrBridge.RBound
                    (NimAudit.AttainCircuit.attR B (N + 1)
                      (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                      (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true) b)
                    (N + 1) B d s) ∧
                NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                        (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B
                          (NimAudit.AttainCircuit.attR B (N + 1)
                            (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                            (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true)))
                        j /
                      NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) =
                    2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) ∧
                  NimAudit.Prob.CorrHyp B (N + 1)
                      (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B
                        (NimAudit.AttainCircuit.attR B (N + 1)
                          (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) false)
                          (NimAudit.Attain.fibreRep B (NimAudit.Prob.headVec j) true)))
                      ε ∧
                    ∀ (R : Bool → NimAudit.CorrBridge.RCirc),
                      (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.CorrBridge.RBound (R b) (N + 1) B d s) →
                        NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1) (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B R) j /
                            NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
                          2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

doc:
EARLY-EXIT SEMANTIC THEOREM (B ≥ 1): after the reset, the controller stops after exactly
T = eeT ticks (running at every earlier tick), with decision dec = [nim(P) ≠ 0]; the
decision and the number of queries are those of Misc.shootout run on the actual
rollout outcomes; T ≤ Tmax.
name: NimAudit.Shootout.ee_spec
type:
∀ {B : ℕ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {P : List ℕ},
      NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
        (NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P (NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0)
                (NimAudit.Shootout.initOS B P)).run =
            false ∧
          (NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P (NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0)
                  (NimAudit.Shootout.initOS B P)).dec =
              decide (NimAudit.nimSum P ≠ 0) ∧
            (∀ u < NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0,
                (NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P u (NimAudit.Shootout.initOS B P)).run = true) ∧
              some
                    (NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P (NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0)
                        (NimAudit.Shootout.initOS B P)).dec =
                  ((NimAudit.Misc.shootout B).run (fun h => NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner h P) (B + 1)
                      0).1 ∧
                NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0 =
                    ((NimAudit.Misc.shootout B).run (fun h => NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner h P)
                        (B + 1) 0).2 ∧
                  NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0 ≤ B ∧
                    NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0 ≤ NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B P.length ∧
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.arun true B P (NimAudit.Shootout.eeT B P (B - 1) 0)
                              (NimAudit.Shootout.initOS B P)).j +
                          1 =
                        NimAudit.Shootout.eeR P (B - 1) 0

UNIQUENESS: a character that agrees with the delta bit q on every single-change pair of
B-bit boards is the global parity character.  So, for N ≥ 2, no character of degree
less than 2N (in particular no degree-two character) agrees with the delta map on the
promised single-change domain; the local circuit dC is a different total extension,
and is not a character at all (dC_not_character).
name: NimAudit.Fourier.char_unique
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.Field R] [inst_1 : LE R] [inst_2 : LT R] [Std.LawfulOrderLT R]
  [inst_4 : Std.IsLinearOrder R] [Grind.OrderedRing R] {B N q : ℕ},
  q < B →
    ∀ {S : List Bool},
      S ∈ NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (2 * (B * N)) →
        (∀ (Q Q' : List ℕ),
            Q.length = N →
              Q'.length = N →
                NimAudit.Game.Width B Q →
                  NimAudit.Game.Width B Q' →
                    NimAudit.LocalRestore.OneChange Q Q' →
                      NimAudit.Fourier.chi S (NimAudit.Fourier.enc B N Q Q') =
                        NimAudit.Noise.sg ((NimAudit.nimSum Q ^^^ NimAudit.nimSum Q').testBit q)) →
          S = NimAudit.Fourier.gMask B N q

name: NimAudit.Bypass.bypass_barriers
type:
NimAudit.Barrier.ParityNotAC0 →
  (∀ (S : ℕ → NimAudit.BinReadout.BCirc) (r : ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ),
      NimAudit.Family.AC0Fam NimAudit.Barrier.encAdm NimAudit.Barrier.encLen
          (fun m => NimAudit.ThresholdInst.bForms (S m)) d →
        (∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → (S m).idx.length = r m ∧ (S m).val.length = 2 ∧ m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r m) →
          ¬∀ (m : ℕ),
              1 ≤ m →
                ∀ (y : List Bool),
                  y.length = m →
                    NimAudit.ParityCircuit.binMove (S m) (m + 1) (NimAudit.Game.encode y) =
                      NimAudit.RolloutExec.mhExec 2 (NimAudit.Game.encode y)) ∧
    (∀ (S : ℕ → NimAudit.BinReadout.BCirc) (r : ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ),
        NimAudit.Family.AC0Fam NimAudit.Barrier.encAdm NimAudit.Barrier.encLen
            (fun m => NimAudit.ThresholdInst.bForms (S m)) d →
          (∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → (S m).idx.length = r m ∧ (S m).val.length = 2 ∧ m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r m) →
            ¬∀ (m : ℕ),
                1 ≤ m →
                  ∀ (y : List Bool),
                    y.length = m →
                      NimAudit.ParityCircuit.binMove (S m) (m + 1) (NimAudit.Game.encode y) =
                        NimAudit.Barrier.recMove 2 (NimAudit.Game.encode y)) ∧
      (∀ (net : ℕ → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer) (r : ℕ → ℕ) (W L : ℕ),
          NimAudit.Family.NetFam NimAudit.Barrier.encAdm NimAudit.Barrier.encLen net W L →
            (∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r m) →
              ¬∀ (m : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ m →
                    ∀ (y : List Bool),
                      y.length = m →
                        NimAudit.ThresholdInst.netBinSem (net m) (m + 1) (r m) 2
                            (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits 2 (NimAudit.Game.encode y)) =
                          NimAudit.RolloutExec.mhExec 2 (NimAudit.Game.encode y)) ∧
        (∀ (net : ℕ → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer) (r : ℕ → ℕ) (W L : ℕ),
            NimAudit.Family.NetFam NimAudit.Barrier.encAdm NimAudit.Barrier.encLen net W L →
              (∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r m) →
                ¬∀ (m : ℕ),
                    1 ≤ m →
                      ∀ (y : List Bool),
                        y.length = m →
                          NimAudit.ThresholdInst.netBinSem (net m) (m + 1) (r m) 2
                              (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits 2 (NimAudit.Game.encode y)) =
                            NimAudit.Barrier.recMove 2 (NimAudit.Game.encode y)) ∧
          ∀ (G : ℕ → List NimAudit.AC0.Circ) (d : ℕ),
            NimAudit.Family.AC0Fam NimAudit.Barrier.encAdm (fun m => m) G d →
              ¬∀ (m : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ m →
                    ∀ (y : List Bool),
                      y.length = m →
                        ∃ Q,
                          Q.length = m + 1 ∧
                            NimAudit.nimSum Q = 0 ∧
                              NimAudit.Game.Move Q (NimAudit.Game.encode y) ∧
                                ∀ w < 2 * (m + 1),
                                  NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Bridge.vfun y)
                                      (NimAudit.CorrBridge.getC (G m) w) =
                                    NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits 2 Q w

doc:
WORK OF A RUN (formula nodes evaluated, reset tick included): early exit and all heads,
with the exact tick counts, are bounded by the padded-clock work (1 + Tmax)·SW·Fz.
name: NimAudit.Shootout.run_work
type:

  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {P : List ℕ},
      P.length = N →

                  NimAudit.Family.tsize (NimAudit.Shootout.cForms early B N r) ≤

                  (NimAudit.Shootout.SW B N r * NimAudit.Shootout.Fz B N r) ∧
              (1 + NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P (B - 1) 0) *
                  NimAudit.Family.tsize (NimAudit.Shootout.cForms early B N r) ≤
                (1 + NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B N) *

              NimAudit.AC0.rnnSize W M cell.length T ∧

doc:
A4 SAMPLE SIZES FOR THE FLIP MODEL: for 0 ≤ ε < 1/2 and a = (1 − 2ε)^L ≤ 1/2, with errors
computed on the space of m·L independent flips (fresh blocks):
  majority succeeds for every m ≥ ⌈4/a²⌉₊;  every randomized rule with both errors ≤ 1/4
  needs 32·m·a² ≥ 3;  and the minimum sufficient m satisfies the Θ(a^{-2}) bounds.
name: NimAudit.RealNoise.flip_samples
type:
∀ {ε : ℝ},
  ε < 1 / 2 →
    ∀ (L : ℕ),
      (1 - 2 * ε) ^ L ≤ 1 / 2 →
        (∀ (m : ℕ),
            NimAudit.RealNoise.mUp ((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L) ≤ m →
              (NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                    NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e *
                      NimAudit.Noise.detRule NimAudit.Noise.maj
                        (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf false L m e)) ≤
                  1 / 4 ∧
                (NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                    NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e *
                      (1 -
                        NimAudit.Noise.detRule NimAudit.Noise.maj
                          (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf true L m e))) ≤
                  1 / 4) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ) (φ : List Bool → ℝ),
              NimAudit.Noise.Rule m φ →
                (NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                      NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e * φ (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf false L m e)) ≤
                    1 / 4 →
                  (NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                        NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e * (1 - φ (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf true L m e))) ≤
                      1 / 4 →
                    3 / (32 * ((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L) ^ 2) ≤ ↑m) ∧
            3 / 32 * (((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ ↑(NimAudit.RealNoise.mMin ((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L)) ∧
              ↑(NimAudit.RealNoise.mMin ((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L)) ≤ 17 / 4 * (((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L) ^ 2)⁻¹

CONDITIONAL BRIDGE (paper Appendix G(i), circuit part).  Let the readout be
given, for each observed bit b, by formulas R b with the resource bounds of
`RBound` (depth ≤ d, size ≤ s, reading the N·B input bits).  ASSUME the
classical parity-correlation premise for formulas of depth ≤ d + 11 and size
≤ 12 U^10 (U = (N+2)(B+2)(s+2)) on every m with N ≤ m ≤ B·N, with error ε.
Then the phase-2 hypothesis CorrHyp B N (readoutOf B R) ε holds.

    ∀ {ε : ℚ},
      (∀ (m : ℕ),
          N ≤ m →
            m ≤ B * N →
              NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (d + 11) (12 * NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar N B s ^ 10)

        NimAudit.Prob.CorrHyp B N (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B R) ε

doc:
BOUNDED WITNESS LEMMA.  If the gate fires on z, there is a list T of at most
b ≤ W distinct input positions, all with true literal and positive coefficient,
whose coefficients sum to at least b; T is an initial segment of the active
literals (T = active literals below a cut c').
name: NimAudit.AC0.Gate.bounded_witness
type:
∀ (g : NimAudit.AC0.Gate) (z : ℕ → Bool),
  g.eval z = true →
    ∃ c' ≤ g.fanin,
      (g.active z c').length ≤ g.thr ∧
        (∀ j ∈ g.active z c', g.lit z j = true ∧ 1 ≤ g.coeff j ∧ j < c') ∧
          g.thr ≤ NimAudit.AC0.nsum g.fanin fun j => if j ∈ g.active z c' then g.coeff j else 0

doc:
FINITE-INPUT FAMILY THEOREM.  Fix W, L, c, k, c', k'.  For each input length n let
net n be a valid network with exactly L layers whose fan-ins and widths are
≤ c (n+1)^k, with K n ≤ c' (n+1)^k' designated output bits.  Then each output i
is computed (zero-extended n-bit semantics) by one formula that reads only
inputs < n, has depth ≤ 3L and size ≤ 2 (2W+3)^L (c+1)^(WL) (n+1)^(kWL); the
total size of the K n output formulas is ≤ c'(n+1)^k' times that bound.
name: NimAudit.FiniteNet.family_finite
type:
∀ {W L c k c' k' : ℕ} (net : ℕ → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer) (K : ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (net n).length = L) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W (net n)) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded (c * (n + 1) ^ k) (net n)) →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), K n ≤ c' * (n + 1) ^ k') →
          ∀ (n : ℕ),
            (∀ (i : ℕ),
                (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool),
                    NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n (net n) i) =
                      NimAudit.AC0.evalNet (net n) (NimAudit.FiniteNet.pad n x) i) ∧
                  (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n (net n) i).depth ≤ 3 * L ∧
                    (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n (net n) i).size ≤
                        2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ L * ((c + 1) ^ (W * L) * (n + 1) ^ (k * (W * L)))) ∧
                      (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n (net n) i).maxInput ≤ n) ∧
              NimAudit.FiniteNet.totalSize W n (net n) (K n) ≤
                c' * (n + 1) ^ k' *
                  (2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ L * ((c + 1) ^ (W * L) * (n + 1) ^ (k * (W * L)))))

    (List.foldl NimAudit.Recurrent.storeStep { acc := 0, board := [] } P).board = P ∧
      (∀ (q : List ℕ),
          NimAudit.Game.selectMove
                (List.foldl NimAudit.Recurrent.storeStep { acc := 0, board := [] } P).acc
                (List.foldl NimAudit.Recurrent.storeStep { acc := 0, board := [] } P).board =

                (List.foldl NimAudit.Recurrent.storeStep { acc := 0, board := [] } P).acc

              none ↔
            NimAudit.Game.Terminal P) ∧
          (NimAudit.nimSum P ≠ 0 →
            ∃ q,
              NimAudit.Game.selectMove
                    (List.foldl NimAudit.Recurrent.storeStep { acc := 0, board := [] } P).acc

board R (nim(R) = 0) before the opponent's board P', the reported difference at P'
is the opponent's one-heap delta x ⊕ z, which equals nim(P') (the restoration target).
name: NimAudit.Bypass.diff_with_postMove
type:
∀ {B N : ℕ} {P0 R P' : List ℕ},
  N < 2 ^ NimAudit.WholeGame.rIdx N →
    P0.length = N ∧ NimAudit.Game.Width B P0 →
      R.length = N ∧ NimAudit.Game.Width B R →
        P'.length = N ∧ NimAudit.Game.Width B P' →
          NimAudit.nimSum R = 0 →
            NimAudit.Game.Move R P' →
              ∃ pre x post z,
                R = pre ++ x :: post ∧
                  P' = pre ++ z :: post ∧
                    (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.trun B (NimAudit.WholeGame.rIdx N)
                              (NimAudit.ControllerBits.sbits B (NimAudit.WholeGame.rIdx N)
                                NimAudit.Controller.cinit)
                              (NimAudit.Controller.stream [P0, R, P'])).2[4]? =
                        some
                          (NimAudit.Controller.COut.summary (NimAudit.nimSum P') (some (x ^^^ z))) ∧
                      x ^^^ z = NimAudit.nimSum P'

doc:
The network readout bound with the classical theorem assumed in the shared-circuit
convention (same depth and size parameters as `BinReadout.network_readout_bound`).
name: NimAudit.Shared.network_readout_bound_dag
type:
∀ {W M B N j r L : ℕ},
  j < B →
    ∀ (nets : Bool → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
      (∀ (b : Bool), (nets b).length = L) →
        (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W (nets b)) →
          (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M (nets b)) →
            N + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r →
              ∀ {ε : ℚ},
                (∀ (m : ℕ),
                    N + 1 ≤ m →
                      m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                        NimAudit.Shared.DagParityPremise (3 * L + 2 + 11)
                          (12 *
                            NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B
                                ((r + 1) * (2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ L * (M + 1) ^ (W * L)) + 1)) ^
                              10)
                          m ε) →
                  NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1)
                        (NimAudit.BinReadout.binReadoutOf B (N + 1) fun b =>
                          NimAudit.BinReadout.netBCirc W B (N + 1) r (nets b))
                        j /
                      NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
                    2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

doc:

well-formed stream, the threshold controller's state vector is the canonical encoding
of a reachable semantic state whose registers fit (counter included, no overflow) and

  N < 2 ^ r →
    ∀ (Ps : List (List ℕ)),
      (∀ P ∈ Ps, P.length = N ∧ NimAudit.Game.Width B P) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          ∃
            st ∈
              NimAudit.Controller.crunStates NimAudit.Controller.cinit
                (NimAudit.Controller.stream Ps),
            (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.trun B r
                    (NimAudit.ControllerBits.sbits B r NimAudit.Controller.cinit)
                    (List.take k (NimAudit.Controller.stream Ps))).1 =
                NimAudit.ControllerBits.sbits B r st ∧
              NimAudit.ControllerBits.FitsR B r st ∧
                NimAudit.ControllerBits.decodeS B r (NimAudit.ControllerBits.sbits B r st) = st

doc:

N row updates and the separator update produce the encoding of the idle state storing
P, and the outputs at the separator decode to (nim(P), decisionMove P).
name: NimAudit.BoardStore.bits_decision
type:
∀ {B N r r' : ℕ},
  N < 2 ^ r →
    N ≤ 2 ^ r' →
      ∀ (b : List ℕ),
        b.length = N →
          NimAudit.Game.Width B b →
            ∀ (P : List ℕ),
              P.length = N →
                NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
                  NimAudit.BoardStore.bsBitRun B N r
                        (NimAudit.BoardStore.bsBits B N r { board := b, acc := 0, idx := 0 })
                        (NimAudit.BoardStore.btoks P) =
                      NimAudit.BoardStore.bsBits B N r { board := P, acc := 0, idx := 0 } ∧
                    NimAudit.BoardStore.bsDecode B N r r'
                        (NimAudit.BoardStore.inB B N r
                          (NimAudit.BoardStore.bsBitRun B N r
                            (NimAudit.BoardStore.bsBits B N r { board := b, acc := 0, idx := 0 })
                            (List.map NimAudit.Controller.Tok.row P))
                          NimAudit.Controller.Tok.sep) =
                      some { sum := NimAudit.nimSum P, move := NimAudit.Controller.decisionMove P }

doc: PER-MASK BOUND (unnormalised): |Σ_x ind(C x)·(−1)^{par x}| ≤ #bad · 2^#stars.
name: NimAudit.Foundation.mask_bound
type:
∀ (mask : List Bool) (C : NimAudit.AC0.Circ),
  C.maxInput ≤ mask.length →
    ∀ (τ : List Bool → List Bool → Option NimAudit.Foundation.DTree),
      (-((NimAudit.Prob.rsum (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (NimAudit.Bridge.zeros mask)) fun ρ =>
                NimAudit.Bridge.ind (NimAudit.Foundation.badR C τ mask ρ)) *
              2 ^ NimAudit.Bridge.ones mask) ≤
          NimAudit.Prob.rsum (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs mask.length) fun x =>
            NimAudit.Bridge.ind (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Bridge.vfun x) C) *
              NimAudit.Bridge.sgn (NimAudit.Bridge.par x)) ∧
        (NimAudit.Prob.rsum (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs mask.length) fun x =>
            NimAudit.Bridge.ind (NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval (NimAudit.Bridge.vfun x) C) *
              NimAudit.Bridge.sgn (NimAudit.Bridge.par x)) ≤
          (NimAudit.Prob.rsum (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (NimAudit.Bridge.zeros mask)) fun ρ =>
              NimAudit.Bridge.ind (NimAudit.Foundation.badR C τ mask ρ)) *
            2 ^ NimAudit.Bridge.ones mask

name: NimAudit.Noise.chiG_bias
type:

doc:
WEAK MASTERY = WINNING MOVES ON POLICY-CONSISTENT HISTORIES: σ is weakly masterful for F
and r iff, from every winnable initial board of F, at every history consistent with σ's
own preceding actions where σ is to move, σ plays a legal move to a P-position.  Contrast
StrongMastery below, which asks this on ALL legal histories.

type:
∀ (F : List ℕ → Prop) (r : NimAudit.Mastery.Role) (σ : NimAudit.Mastery.Strat),
  NimAudit.Mastery.WeakMastery F r σ ↔
    ∀ (P0 : List ℕ),
      F P0 →
        NimAudit.Mastery.RoleWinnable r P0 →
          ∀ (h : NimAudit.Mastery.Hist),
            NimAudit.Mastery.Cons r σ P0 h →
              NimAudit.Mastery.mover h = r →
                ∃ Q,
                  σ h = some Q ∧
                    NimAudit.Game.Move (NimAudit.Mastery.cur h) Q ∧ NimAudit.nimSum Q = 0

doc:
SUMMARY-ONLY NETWORK: the summary registers' updates and summary outputs are computed
by a W = 1 network with at most 18 layers and at most 17·35·(4+4B) + 4 + 4B gates,
i.e. O(B) gates (the replay part is what adds the B² and log N terms).
name: NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryNet_res
type:
∀ (B r : ℕ),
  (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryForms B r).length),
      NimAudit.AC0.evalNet
          (NimAudit.ThresholdNet.compileF (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryForms B r)) x k =
        NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryForms B r)[k]) ∧
    NimAudit.AC0.NetValid 1
        (NimAudit.ThresholdNet.compileF (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryForms B r)) ∧
      (NimAudit.ThresholdNet.compileF (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryForms B r)).length ≤ 18 ∧
        NimAudit.ThresholdNet.gateCount
            (NimAudit.ThresholdNet.compileF (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.summaryForms B r)) ≤
          17 * (35 * (4 + 4 * B)) + (4 + 4 * B)

  a0 ≠ 0 →
    a1 ≠ 0 →

        a1 < 2 ^ B →
          N ≤ 2 ^ r →
            ∀ {P : List ℕ},
              P.length = N →
                NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
                  ∀ (b : Bool),
                    NimAudit.ThresholdInst.netBinSem
                        (NimAudit.ThresholdInst.attainNet B N r a0 a1 b) N r B
                        (NimAudit.CorrBridge.boardBits B P) =
                      NimAudit.Attain.attainF a0 a1 P b

started from an idle fitting state, EVERY visited state has acc, prev, sig < 2^B,

  NimAudit.Controller.Idle s →

      ∀ (Ps : List (List ℕ)),
        (∀ P ∈ Ps, P.length = N ∧ NimAudit.Game.Width B P) →
          ∀ st ∈ NimAudit.Controller.crunStates s (NimAudit.Controller.stream Ps),
            NimAudit.Controller.Fits B N st

doc:
RESTORATION FROM THE STREAM: if the previous position Q had nim-sum zero and the
opponent moved legally to Q', the difference reported at Q's successor drives a
legal move to nim-sum zero (cancel the reported difference at the first
qualifying heap).

  NimAudit.nimSum Q = 0 →
    NimAudit.Game.Move Q Q' →
      ∃ R,
        NimAudit.Game.cancelFirst (NimAudit.nimSum Q ^^^ NimAudit.nimSum Q') Q' = some R ∧
          NimAudit.Game.Move Q' R ∧ NimAudit.nimSum R = 0

2 value bits) has strong mastery on 2-bit boards with m+1 heaps, then
parityFormula S m computes parity of every y ∈ {0,1}^m, has depth ≤ d and size
≤ s, and reads only the m parity inputs.
name: NimAudit.ParityCircuit.extraction
type:

  NimAudit.BinReadout.BBound S (m + 1) 2 r d s →
    NimAudit.ParityCircuit.StrongMastery S (m + 1) →
      (∀ (y : List Bool),
          y.length = m →

        (NimAudit.ParityCircuit.parityFormula S m).depth ≤ d ∧
          (NimAudit.ParityCircuit.parityFormula S m).size ≤ s ∧
            (NimAudit.ParityCircuit.parityFormula S m).maxInput ≤ m

doc:
B6, SPECIALISED to the flip model: a = (1 − 2ε)^L, p = P[Ỹ = Y].  If 0 ≤ ε, 2ε < 1
and (1 − 2ε)^L ≤ 1/2, then for m fresh repetitions (error space of m·L independent
flips): m·a² ≥ 4 suffices (majority), and any randomized rule with both errors ≤ 1/4
needs 32·m·a² ≥ 3.  Errors are computed directly on the error space.  (0 ≤ ε is not
needed as a hypothesis: the regime condition 2a ≤ 1 with a > 0 is what is used; the
error law is a probability law when 0 ≤ ε ≤ 1, fw_nonneg.)
name: NimAudit.Noise.flip_order_inv_sq
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.Field R] [inst_1 : LE R] [inst_2 : LT R] [Std.LawfulOrderLT R]
  [inst_4 : Std.IsLinearOrder R] [Grind.OrderedRing R] (ε : R) (L : ℕ),
  2 * ε < 1 →
    2 * (1 - 2 * ε) ^ L ≤ 1 →
      (∀ (m : ℕ),
          4 ≤ ↑m * ((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L) ^ 2 →
            (4 *
                  NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                    NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e *
                      NimAudit.Noise.detRule NimAudit.Noise.maj
                        (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf false L m e)) ≤
                1 ∧
              (4 *
                  NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                    NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e *
                      (1 -
                        NimAudit.Noise.detRule NimAudit.Noise.maj
                          (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf true L m e))) ≤
                1) ∧
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (φ : List Bool → R),
          NimAudit.Noise.Rule m φ →
            (4 *
                  NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                    NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e * φ (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf false L m e)) ≤
                1 →
              (4 *
                    NimAudit.Noise.gs (NimAudit.Bridge.bitvecs (m * L)) fun e =>
                      NimAudit.Noise.fw ε e * (1 - φ (NimAudit.Noise.obsOf true L m e))) ≤
                  1 →
                3 ≤ 32 * (↑m * ((1 - 2 * ε) ^ L) ^ 2)

doc:
ALL-HEAD HALTING LOOP: after the reset, the loop on the run wire stops after exactly
ahT = totalRolloutMoves + 2B ticks with every outcome stored.
name: NimAudit.Shootout.ah_loop
type:
∀ {B N r : ℕ},
  1 ≤ B →
    B ≤ 2 ^ r →
      ∀ {P : List ℕ},
        P.length = N →
          NimAudit.Game.Width B P →
            ∀ (x0 : ℕ → Bool),
              (NimAudit.Shootout.loopRun (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep false B N r P false) (B * N + 2)
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B N)
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep false B N r P true x0)).2 =
                  NimAudit.Shootout.ahT P (B - 1) 0 ∧
                ∀ h < B,
                  (NimAudit.Shootout.loopRun (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep false B N r P false)
                          (B * N + 2) (NimAudit.Shootout.Tmax B N)
                          (NimAudit.Shootout.cstep false B N r P true x0)).1
                      (NimAudit.Shootout.oW B N r h) =
                    NimAudit.Game.rolloutWinner h P

doc: FIRST AND SECOND MOMENTS: E[D] = 0 and E[D²] = m·p·(1 − p).
name: NimAudit.Noise.chan_moments
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.Field R] [inst_1 : LE R] [inst_2 : LT R] [Std.LawfulOrderLT R]

doc:

            (NimAudit.Prob.expect B N fun P =>
                NimAudit.Prob.H F b a P * if NimAudit.nimSum P = a then 1 else 0) -
              1 / ↑(2 ^ B) * NimAudit.Prob.expect B N fun P => NimAudit.Prob.H F b a P) ∧
          ((NimAudit.Prob.expect B N fun P =>
                NimAudit.Prob.H F b a P * if NimAudit.nimSum P = a then 1 else 0) -
              1 / ↑(2 ^ B) * NimAudit.Prob.expect B N fun P => NimAudit.Prob.H F b a P) ≤

                      NimAudit.Game.Wins (NimAudit.RolloutExec.mhExecSel B) P ∧

doc:
NETWORK-FAMILY SIMULATION.  Fix W, L, c, k.  Let (net n) be valid networks with
exactly L layers whose fan-ins and widths are ≤ c (n+1)^k.  Then every output of
net n is computed by a formula of depth ≤ 3L and size
  ≤ 2 (2W+3)^L (c+1)^(W L) (n+1)^(k W L),
a polynomial in n whose degree k W L and constant depend only on W, L, c, k.
name: NimAudit.AC0.family_ac0
type:
∀ {W L c k : ℕ} (net : ℕ → List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (net n).length = L) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), NimAudit.AC0.NetValid W (net n)) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded (c * (n + 1) ^ k) (net n)) →
        ∀ (n i : ℕ),
          (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool),
              NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x
                  (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W (net n) NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input i) =
                NimAudit.AC0.evalNet (net n) x i) ∧
            (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W (net n) NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input i).depth ≤ 3 * L ∧
              (NimAudit.AC0.compileNet W (net n) NimAudit.AC0.Circ.input i).size ≤
                2 * ((2 * W + 3) ^ L * ((c + 1) ^ (W * L) * (n + 1) ^ (k * (W * L))))

  NimAudit.Prob.dotB B (u ^^^ w) v = (NimAudit.Prob.dotB B u v ^^ NimAudit.Prob.dotB B w v)

name: NimAudit.Barrier.enc_poly

doc:
Per-update circuit resources: depth ≤ 4, total size ≤ 28 B + 8 for all
state and output bits (constant depth, O(B) size).
name: NimAudit.Recurrent.circuit_resources
type:
∀ (B k : ℕ),
  (NimAudit.Recurrent.accC B k).depth ≤ 4 ∧
    (NimAudit.Recurrent.prevC B k).depth ≤ 4 ∧
      (NimAudit.Recurrent.validC B).depth ≤ 4 ∧
        (NimAudit.Recurrent.diffC B k).depth ≤ 4 ∧
          (NimAudit.Recurrent.diffValidC B).depth ≤ 4 ∧
            (NimAudit.Recurrent.accC B k).size + (NimAudit.Recurrent.prevC B k).size +
                  (NimAudit.Recurrent.diffC B k).size ≤
                28 ∧
              (NimAudit.Recurrent.validC B).size + (NimAudit.Recurrent.diffValidC B).size ≤ 8

doc:
FIXED GRID: every gate of a compiled network fires in the paper's rational form with
denominator D = 1 exactly when it fires in integer form (weights in {0,1}, threshold
in {0,1}).
name: NimAudit.ThresholdNet.compileF_fixed_grid
type:
∀ (cs : List NimAudit.AC0.Circ),
  ∀ l ∈ NimAudit.ThresholdNet.compileF cs,
    ∀ g ∈ l,
      NimAudit.AC0.Gate.Valid 1 g ∧ ∀ (z : ℕ → Bool), NimAudit.AC0.ratFires g 1 z ↔ g.eval z = true

doc:
Combined with phase 2: under the same premise, the circuit readout fed the
executed outcome of head pi_j succeeds with conditional probability at most
2/(2^B-1) + (2^B-1) ε.
name: NimAudit.CorrBridge.circuit_readout_bound
type:
∀ {B N j d s : ℕ},
  j < B →
    ∀ (R : Bool → NimAudit.CorrBridge.RCirc),
      (∀ (b : Bool), NimAudit.CorrBridge.RBound (R b) (N + 1) B d s) →
        ∀ {ε : ℚ},
          (∀ (m : ℕ),
              N + 1 ≤ m →
                m ≤ B * (N + 1) →
                  NimAudit.Bridge.ParityCorrPremise (d + 11)
                    (12 * NimAudit.CorrBridge.Upar (N + 1) B s ^ 10) m ε) →
            NimAudit.Prob.succCountRO B (N + 1) (NimAudit.CorrBridge.readoutOf B R) j /
                NimAudit.Prob.nonzeroCount B (N + 1) ≤
              2 / (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) + (↑(2 ^ B) - 1) * ε

doc:
A finite-state controller over rollout heads: states are numbers; `head s` is the head

doc:
UNFOLDING: a shared circuit of depth D and fan-in ≤ F (F ≥ 1) unfolds into a
formula computing the same function, of the same depth and size ≤ (F+1)^D.
name: NimAudit.Shared.formula_size
type:
∀ {F : ℕ},
  1 ≤ F →
    ∀ (D : NimAudit.Shared.Dag), NimAudit.Shared.Dag.Fanin F D → D.formula.size ≤ (F + 1) ^ D.depth

doc: A3 TWO-SIDED BOUNDS: 3/(32a²) ≤ mMin a ≤ ⌈4/a²⌉₊ < 4/a² + 1.
name: NimAudit.RealNoise.mMin_bounds
type:
∀ {a : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ 1 / 2 →
      3 / (32 * a ^ 2) ≤ ↑(NimAudit.RealNoise.mMin a) ∧
        NimAudit.RealNoise.mMin a ≤ NimAudit.RealNoise.mUp a ∧
          ↑(NimAudit.RealNoise.mUp a) < 4 / a ^ 2 + 1

doc: Every wire below SW is a board, par, halt, run, dec, index or outcome wire.
name: NimAudit.Shootout.wire_cases
type:
∀ (B N r w : ℕ),
  w < NimAudit.Shootout.SW B N r →
    w < B * N ∨
      w = B * N ∨
        w = B * N + 1 ∨
          w = B * N + 2 ∨
            w = B * N + 3 ∨
              (∃ q < r, w = NimAudit.Shootout.jW B N q) ∨ ∃ h < B, w = NimAudit.Shootout.oW B N r h

doc: The formula depends only on the first n input bits.
name: NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula_local
type:
∀ {W M : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (ls : List NimAudit.AC0.Layer),
  NimAudit.AC0.NetBounded M ls →
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (x y : ℕ → Bool),
      (∀ j < n, x j = y j) →
        NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval x (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n ls i) =
          NimAudit.AC0.Circ.eval y (NimAudit.FiniteNet.netFormula W n ls i)

      (t : NimAudit.ControllerBits.FitsR B r s) →
        ((acc : s.acc < 2 ^ B) →
            (prev : s.prev < 2 ^ B) →

          motive t
